original_value: The ultimate in performance, upgraded. Faster than the 970 EVO, the 970 EVO Plus is powered by the latest V-NAND technology and firmware optimization. It maximizes the potential of NVMe bandwidth for unbeatable computing. Comes in capacities of up to 2TB, with reliability of up to 1,200 TBW.

result.paraphrase: An upgraded, top-tier performance drive, the 970 EVO Plus is faster than the 970 EVO and uses the latest V-NAND technology plus firmware optimization. It makes the most of NVMe bandwidth for exceptional computing performance. Available in capacities up to 2TB, with reliability rated up to 1,200 TBW.
